items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: when I first had the pleasure of seeing him, see, at Mr. Tom Bailey's theaters.

ctx.x: Who were the ones that you felt --

Well there was Nipsy Russell. See, that's who I thought was going to break the new ground. See, he was known as a -- the dancing chauffeur, when I first had the pleasure of seeing him, see, at Mr. Tom Bailey's theaters. You see, I think that was at the 91, see. And he was doing other things, you see, at that time. See? He used to show the -- what'd you call it, the tourists different descriptions, you know, on the countryside.
